// Retention and deletion lifecycle
Load customer text / audio retention policy
Is text retention allowed and within retention period?
Store transcript text events for restore and debrief
Expire or omit transcript projection under policy
DELETE /api/sessions/:sessionId
Authenticate owner or authorized customer administrator
Delete app-owned session · seed · facts · ledgers · transcript
Request provider-context deletion where supported by policy
Purge explicitly retained raw audio
Record minimal deletion status if policy requires it
// Scenario termination, archive handoff, temporary-state expiry, and durable records
Scenario completes or is cancelled
Worker records terminal state and unique archive job in PostgreSQL
Idempotent worker builds archive from PostgreSQL and retained audio
Verify private archive contents and metadata before publishing
Authorize download until terminal time +72 hours
mint short-lived URL
Set RedisJSON absolute expiry at terminal time +20 minutes
Persist session · stats · provider usage · downloads · outcomes in PostgreSQL
Retry archive idempotently from PostgreSQL and retained audio source
Deny downloads initiated after 72 hours
asynchronously delete expired artifact
// Scale-out and latency controls
Begin with one API replica and PostgreSQL durable transactions
Require RedisJSON for live session state and Redis Streams for event handoff
Measure cross-replica coordination and websocket needs
Add extra Redis pub/sub and rate-limit state only when measured
Reconcile absolute terminal +20-minute expiry through PostgreSQL outbox
PostgreSQL stores durable clinical ledger · client records · metrics
Bound setup queue · concurrency · timeout · retries
Reserve capacity for interactive turns
Bound post-session scoring separately
Back-pressure requests and serialize each session

Add worker pool only if setup / scoring harms measured turn latency
Keep one modular API when no measured interference exists
Commit active state · reply · retry key · event in one Redis round trip
Dedicated workers persist events · metrics · archives asynchronously
Never await side work
keep nonblocking handoff under 5 milliseconds

never parallelize a session
Measure side-work wait (zero target) and handoff overhead (<5 ms)
Track stream age · backlog size · PostgreSQL worker lag
